typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Manrope (sans-serif, robust, technical)
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (excellent legibility for numbers and serial codes)

colors.background: bg-slate-50 (off-white for reduced glare in warehouse)
colors.primary: bg-blue-600 (International Klein Blue) - high contrast for main actions
colors.secondary: bg-slate-900 (deep charcoal for text and secondary actions)
colors.accent: bg-amber-400 (Warning Yellow) - for scanning action highlights
colors.destructive: bg-red-600 (Signal Red) - for removing items or errors

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200/40) for structure. Avoid soft shadows to maintain a sharp, technical feel. Max border-radius: 6px (rounded-md).
visual_enhancers.touch_targets: CRITICAL: All buttons, inputs, and touch targets MUST be at least 48px height (h-12) for glove/warehouse usability.
visual_enhancers.feedback: Provide immediate visual feedback on scan or quantity change. Use 'sonner' for success/error toasts.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for a technical, crisp look.

layout.general: Mobile-first, optimized for tablet portrait and landscape. Generous padding (p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8) within form sections.
layout.grid: Use Mode B (High Density Grid). For product listings on tablet/desktop, use 2-3 columns. On mobile, use a single column with clear dividing lines.
sections: Header: Sticky top, white background, 1px bottom border, containing App Title.
General Info: Operator Name, Date (default today), Structure (destination text).
Catalog Area: 3 distinct sections or tabs. Each product row has Name, Quantity selector ([-] [value] [+]), and dynamically generated S/N inputs underneath if Quantity > 0 (for Cat 1 & 2 only).
Action Footer: Sticky bottom bar containing 'Invia Checklist' (Submit) button. High visibility.

components.inputs: Shadcn Input, large size (h-12). Left-aligned text.
components.quantity_selector: Custom flex component with large [-] and [+] buttons (h-12 w-12) for easy tapping.
components.sn_inputs: Dynamically rendered below the product. Must include a 'Scan Barcode/QR' icon button nested inside or next to the input to trigger the camera.
components.scanner: Integrate 'html5-qrcode' for a modal-based barcode scanner. Alternatively, provide clear UI for standard keyboard/scanner inputs.
components.toast: Use Sonner for 'Checklist Inviata' or validation errors.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Develop the UI strictly in Italian as per the prompt requirements (e.g., 'Nome Operatore', 'Data Spedizione', 'Struttura', 'Invia Checklist').
Build a responsive React application using Shadcn UI components.

Initialize state for the 3 categories. Cat 1: Wallbox and Daze (Wallbox 7,4 kW - cavo 5 mt, Wallbox 22 kW - cavo 5 mt, Wallbox 22 kW - cavo 7 mt, Daze Duo 44 kW). Cat 2: Meter e Misuratori (Meter Monofase, Meter Trifase, Meter Daze). Cat 3: Accessori e Supporti (Portacavo Pro Wallbox, Portacavo Daze, Stand Wallbox Single, Stand Wallbox Dual, Stand Daze Single).
For Cat 1 & 2: When Quantity > 0, map and render an equal number of input fields for Serial Numbers (S/N). Require these fields for submission.
For Cat 3: Manage Quantity only. No S/N fields.
Implement an 'html5-qrcode' based scanner modal. When the user taps the scan button next to an S/N field, open the camera, capture the code, populate the specific field, and close the modal.
Create an API endpoint to handle the Resend email submission to 'tecnico@eliostech.org'.
The email MUST be formatted as an HTML table summarizing: Nome Operatore, Data, Struttura, and a list of items showing Name, Quantity, and S/Ns (if applicable).
Upon successful email send, show a success toast and reset the entire form state to default.
DO NOT implement authentication. The app opens directly to the checklist form.
Ensure the UI is flat, highly legible, and avoids overlapping elements that could confuse a user in a warehouse environment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this distinctive, highly functional, and technical. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Left-align form labels and inputs. Create a clear reading 'F' pattern.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Use 1px solid borders for definition instead of muddy shadows.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use transitions for specific interactive elements.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid="submit-checklist-btn").
Apply Optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
